---
title: "Impact"
description: "Data Insight in numbers."
---

These figures are computed from the projects published on this site and update automatically.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/projects.json").json()
posts = data.posts
byYear = d3.rollups(posts, v => ({projects: v.length, fellows: new Set(v.map(d => d.author)).size}), d => d.date.slice(0, 4))
  .map(([year, s]) => ({year, ...s}))
html`<p><strong>${posts.length.toLocaleString()}</strong> projects by <strong>${new Set(posts.map(d => d.author)).size}</strong> fellows.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(byYear, {
  header: {year: "Year", projects: "Projects published", fellows: "Fellows publishing"},
  sort: "year", layout: "auto"
})
```
